card.name: Book citations and media-name lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words right after a book title, publisher, or a famous name in a citation or list of public figures and media.

modes.label: Book citation punctuation
modes.description: Period, colon or 'by' in a reference after a book title or publisher city.

modes.label: Lists of famous people or media
modes.description: Comma or 'as' after a celebrity name or in 'such as' lists of magazines and shows.
modes.example: such as Martha Stewart<<,>> Yo Yo Ma, Norman Mineta,

card.writes: It nudges the model toward book, writer and media words such as memoir, Writers, Oprah and columns.
card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation and linking words in book references and lists of famous names, getting ready for publishing or media words.
